== Notes ==
* When used with [[Way of the Empty Palm]] and [[Golden Phoenix Strike]], this skill can be used repeatedly and without using any energy (except to cast Way of the Empty Palm).
* Using this skill without a requisite off-hand attack will cause it to [[fail]], and thus still recharge instantly.
